fundamentals.name: Python
fundamentals.reason: Primary language you already know; required for Django backend development and common in the local market.

fundamentals.name: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
fundamentals.reason: Essential paradigm for organizing backend code, especially in Django and for maintainable systems.

fundamentals.name: Algorithms
fundamentals.reason: Core computer-science skill needed to solve interview problems and optimize backend logic.

fundamentals.name: Data Structures
fundamentals.reason: Fundamental for writing efficient code and solving common programming tasks and interview questions.

frameworks_and_runtime.name: Django
frameworks_and_runtime.reason: High-impact Python backend framework; mastering it provides the fastest path to building production-ready web apps.

databases.name: MySQL
databases.reason: Common relational DB in the job market; practical to learn and frequently requested in listings.

databases.name: SQL
databases.reason: Essential skill to query and manipulate relational databases; required for backend roles.

databases.name: Database Design
databases.reason: Important for building efficient, normalized schemas and understanding relationships in web apps.

version_control_and_ci_cd.name: Git
version_control_and_ci_cd.reason: Non-negotiable for collaborative development and required in every role.

version_control_and_ci_cd.name: GitHub
version_control_and_ci_cd.reason: Platform for hosting projects and portfolio; important for interviews and collaboration.

version_control_and_ci_cd.name: CI/CD (concepts and basic pipelines)
version_control_and_ci_cd.reason: Understanding and implementing simple CI/CD pipelines (e.g., tests + deploy) is essential for production readiness.

testing_and_debugging.name: Unit Testing
testing_and_debugging.reason: Critical for code reliability and a frequent interview requirement (Django testing with pytest/unittest).

testing_and_debugging.name: Debugging
testing_and_debugging.reason: Daily developer skill: being able to trace, reproduce, and fix bugs quickly is essential for job performance.

testing_and_debugging.name: Code Review
testing_and_debugging.reason: Important practice for team quality and collaboration; learn review etiquette and tooling for GitHub PRs.

api_and_networking.name: RESTful API
api_and_networking.reason: Primary API style used in job listings; build and consume REST APIs with Django REST Framework.

api_and_networking.name: Postman
api_and_networking.reason: Practical tool to test and document APIs; quick to learn and useful during development and interviews.

api_and_networking.name: JWT (authentication basics)
api_and_networking.reason: Common method for stateless API authentication; implement simple token-based auth for job projects.

deployment_and_cloud.name: Docker (basic)
deployment_and_cloud.reason: Containerization for consistent dev/prod environments; basic Docker skills are high-impact and learnable in weeks.

deployment_and_cloud.name: AWS (fundamentals)
deployment_and_cloud.reason: Learn core services (EC2, RDS/S3, basic IAM) to deploy and host apps — market-relevant and not as heavy as multi-cloud.

deployment_and_cloud.name: Linux (basic)
deployment_and_cloud.reason: Servers and CI runners use Linux; basic shell, file permissions, and process management are practical and time-efficient to learn.

architecture_and_design.name: Design Patterns (practical ones)
architecture_and_design.reason: Understanding common patterns (Repository, Factory, Singleton where appropriate) helps design maintainable backend code.

architecture_and_design.name: SOLID principles
architecture_and_design.reason: Guides maintainable object-oriented design; directly improves code quality when paired with OOP.

architecture_and_design.name: MVC (concept)
architecture_and_design.reason: Architectural pattern underlying Django; knowing it helps structure apps correctly.

data_and_ai_integration.name: LLM integration (high-level)
data_and_ai_integration.reason: Basic awareness of how to consume and integrate AI APIs (prompting, inference endpoints) can differentiate you without deep ML heaviness.

security_and_scalability.name: Performance Optimization (basics)
security_and_scalability.reason: Know how to profile, identify DB/query hotspots, caching basics (Redis concepts) and optimize endpoints—high ROI for backend roles.

security_and_scalability.name: Scalability concepts (load, caching, connection limits)
security_and_scalability.reason: Understand scaling trade-offs and when to introduce caching, background jobs, or DB sharding at a conceptual level.

communication.name: Communication (written & verbal)
communication.reason: Clear communication is essential for interviews, PR descriptions, and working in teams; practice expressing technical decisions succinctly.

project_management.name: Agile (practical understanding)
project_management.reason: Understanding sprint workflows, stand-ups, and backlog grooming helps you function in most software teams; learn the basics and common ceremonies.

problem_solving.name: Problem Solving (applied)
problem_solving.reason: Focused practice solving coding and system-design problems is essential for interviews and on-the-job success.
